#   xor esi, ecx (32-bit xor)
#   compare sil (lower 8 bits of esi) with target_ct[i]
#   if equal:
#     edx += ecx (32-bit add)

# So: (rolling_key XOR input[i]) & 0xFF == target_ct[i]
# Which means: input[i] = (rolling_key & 0xFF) XOR target_ct[i]

target_ct = bytes([
    0x0b, 0xdf, 0x9e, 0x67, 0x1c, 0x80, 0x21, 0xc8,
    0x69, 0x02, 0xb2, 0x39, 0xe2, 0x7f, 0x16, 0x9a,
